title: Starbase build and combat role

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1132666 (0x0011487a), HLP file offset 288367 (0x0004666f), topic 133 'Starbase Combat'

setup.baseline: An owned planet with no starbase.
setup.variable: Starbase hull, components and attacking fleet.

procedure: Build a starbase and record cost, dock capability and defense.
Attack with a fleet and record starbase initiative and targeting.
Confirm bombing/invasion is blocked while the starbase survives.
Test cloaking and Alternate Reality/Improved Starbases variants.

documented: A starbase can be a shipyard, defensive station and platform for stargate/mass driver; a space dock is required to build ships (documented-only).
A planet cannot be bombed or invaded while its starbase survives; starbases have initiative 10-18 and always strike back (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact hull stats and build costs are in the undecoded tables.
Starbase combat damage arithmetic is unknown.
